title: Inpatients
description: Patients in beds and their medical histories
dischargeHint: Services added during the stay go on the patient account. At discharge they are invoiced and paid.
orderAdded: Order added to the patient account

empty.title: No inpatients
empty.description: Admit via the button above, or from the patient card.

fields.roomEmpty: No free rooms. Add rooms in Settings or wait for a bed.
fields.orderSummary: {total} administrations in total — {days} days at {perDay}× a day.

pickPatientDescription: Find and select the patient — then enter the department, ward and diagnosis.
pickPatientPlaceholder: Search by name, phone or card number...
pickPatientEmpty: Patient not found. Register them first.
pickPatientHint: Type at least 2 characters to search.

dischargeCheck.unbilled: {count} account line(s) not yet invoiced — {total} (auto-invoiced at discharge)
dischargeCheck.debtTitle: Owed for this stay (pay at discharge)
dischargeCheck.acknowledge: Discharge anyway (settle the money later). The outstanding amount is kept on the history and the services stay billable.
dischargeCheck.needsForce: Discharging over an unsettled stay needs administrator or reception rights.

removeHint: The history, its orders and daily notes are removed for good. Services already on an invoice are kept — they are the patient's payment record. This cannot be undone.
removedKeptInvoiced: History deleted. {count} invoiced service(s) were kept.

directBilling.hint: Orders and charges are written to the patient account. Payment is taken at discharge.
directBilling.checkFields: Check the service price, date and number of treatments.
directBilling.noPending: No open balance for this admission.
directBilling.legacy: Legacy order — see invoices in Charges and billing.
directBilling.stopHint: The treatment schedule will stop. Amounts already on the account stay; cancel or refund via billing to adjust.

roomBilling.title: Room charges
roomBilling.rule: Room days are not automatic — enter how many days to add. Mistaken days can be reversed from the list. Amounts go on the patient account and are paid at discharge.
roomBilling.zeroHint: Set 0 in the room catalog for a free bed.
roomBilling.added: One room day was added to the bill
roomBilling.addedMany: {count} room days were added to the bill
roomBilling.enableHint: Save the 24h rate first, then add daily charges manually.
roomBilling.reverseHint: You can reverse a mistaken day under “Added days” — only the latest unpaid day.
roomBilling.editHint: The new rate applies to the next manually added day. Earlier days stay unchanged.
roomBilling.reverseConfirm: Remove the room day for {date} from the bill?
